_comment: Shared contract between frontend and backend. Amounts are in lamports (1 SOL = 1,000,000,000 lamports). Recipient keypairs live in /wallets (gitignored). The look-alike has no private key; regenerate with `python -m scripts.make_lookalike <address>` from backend/.

lessons.title: Connect and understand
lessons.pass: Wallet is connected on devnet and its balance can be read.

lessons.title: Your first send
lessons.pass: Exact submitted transaction succeeded, is confirmed, and matches sender, recipient, and amount.

lessons.title: Scam trap
lessons.pass: User picked the trusted recipient and the transaction to it succeeded and is confirmed.
